data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to connect to ZKTeco fingerprint machines over TCP/IP
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to connect, retrieve attendance logs, user data, and disconnect from fingerprint devices. Supports real‑time and batch data retrieval.
use_when: You need to integrate fingerprint attendance in a Flutter app
You have a ZKTeco or compatible device on the network
You want a simple API without writing native code
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform biometric authentication via device sensors
You require offline storage of attendance data
You need a fully managed backend for attendance
strengths: Built‑in methods for logs and user data
weaknesses: Limited to ZKTeco and similar devices
No support for Android/iOS biometric APIs
No offline storage or sync features
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, create ZKTeco instance, call connect()
